current_grouping: Subpart H — Command and Control Data Link
canonical_title: Command and control data link antenna masking

versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart H — Command and Control data link
versions.title_at_revision: Command and control data link antenna maskings
versions.text:
(a) For all UAV attitudes and orientations relative to the signal source within the design envelope, the UAV antenna margin must be consistent to maintain a sufficient link budget for safe operation.
(b) The masking must be stated in the UAV System Flight Manual.
(c) Warning cues shall be provided to the UAV crew in case of approaching masking attitudes in order to prevent a total loss of command and control data link.
